Issue Summary —
When I try running my game's intro cutscene, it gives a game over partway through even though I programmed no way to get a game over in the code of the event.
Details —
I tried deleting some of the animations that I added to the event to get it to a state where it was working last, but it hasn't solved the issue.

I am not sure how to find a reference for this issue.

full

This is the whole event screenshotted. The Game Over happens when the hero and villain of the cutscene are throwing hands at each other.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
by default, if the actor(s) has < 0 HP, its game over.
to bypass that, there is a plugin to run an event instead.
Tyruswoo plugin has [
Game Over Plugin
] to run a common event.
Hime has [
Game Over Events
] (for MV) which select you the mapId
to go on Game Over, and do whatever you want there.
I don't know if Hime one works or equal to MZ to make it work if you
need to port it.
Tyruswoo allow you set a common event (which you can use, to transfer
the player to the map so you can event the rest.
from there, you can go to game over, or to title scene whatever you prefer.

posts.author: K_Bowman
posts.body: I seem to have figured it out. The issue was caused by Visustella's Unique Tile Effects Plugin. The lava was damaging the player character, and when his HP ran out... I assumed that since he was floating, the burning wouldn't happen in the cutscene. I guess the real issue I am having is now I should figure out how to make the lava not damage the character. Might have to end up just making him an event after all.
